steps.en: Another temporary suspension can be applied during a reduction
steps.id: Suspension sementara lain bisa dikenakan saat masa reduction

steps.en: A reduction can be applied to a notice that already has a temporary suspension
steps.id: Reduction bisa diterapkan pada notice yang sudah punya suspension sementara

steps.en: Reminder letter run checks suspension and skips any suspended notice
steps.id: Proses surat reminder mengecek suspension dan melewati notice yang suspended

steps.en: Preparation for the next stage also skips suspended notices
steps.id: Persiapan data tahap berikutnya juga melewati notice yang suspended

steps.en: SMS and email reminders are not sent during a temporary suspension
steps.id: Reminder SMS dan email tidak dikirim saat suspension sementara
steps.why_en: The check exists, but one suspension reason still gets messages and the job is off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ada, tetapi satu alasan suspension tetap dikirimi pesan dan job-nya mati di produksi.

steps.en: While another suspension or reduction remains, the notice stays suspended
steps.id: Selama suspension atau reduction lain masih ada, notice tetap suspended

steps.en: When all suspensions and the reduction end, reminders can resume
steps.id: Saat semua suspension dan reduction selesai, reminder bisa jalan lagi
